events.title: 회안부 산양현에서 서출로 태어나다
events.title_en: Born out of wedlock in Shanyang County, Huai'an
events.description: 명나라 회안부 산양현에서 태어났다. 증조부와 조부는 학관을 지낸 선비였으나 아버지 대에 집안이 기울어 소상인이 되어 있었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, during the Ming dynasty. His great-grandfather and grandfather had served as scholar-officials, but by his father's generation the family had declined into petty trade.

events.title: 쉰 살에야 성시에 급제해 공생이 되다
events.title_en: He finally passed the provincial exam and became a tribute student at fifty
events.description: 과거에 거듭 낙방하다 쉰 살에 이르러서야 성시에 급제해 공생이 됐다.
events.description_en: After repeated failures in the imperial examinations, he finally passed the provincial exam at the age of fifty and was named a tribute student.

events.title: 남경 국자감에서 십 년을 보내다
events.title_en: He spent a decade at the Imperial Academy in Nanjing
events.description: 남경 국자감에 들어가 십 년 가까이 머물렀다. 이 무렵 술과 풍류에 빠져 지냈다고 전한다.
events.description_en: He entered the Imperial Academy in Nanjing and remained there for nearly a decade. Tradition holds that during this time he gave himself over to drink and idle pleasures.

events.title: 북경으로 가서 벼슬을 구하다
events.title_en: He went to Beijing to seek office
events.description: 왜구의 침입으로 남경이 위태로워지자 방탕한 생활에서 벗어나 북경으로 올라가 벼슬자리를 구했다.
events.description_en: As Japanese pirate raids threatened Nanjing, he broke away from his dissolute life and went north to Beijing to seek a government post.

events.title: 장흥현승에 임명되다
events.title_en: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Changxing County
events.description: 장흥현의 현승으로 임명되어 지방관 생활을 시작했다.
events.description_en: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Changxing County and began his career as a local official.

events.title: 탐관 누명을 쓰고 옥에 갇히다
events.title_en: He was jailed on false charges of corruption
events.description: 부임한 지 두 해가 못 되어 탐관이라는 누명을 쓰고 옥에 갇혔다.
events.description_en: Less than two years into his post, he was falsely accused of corruption and thrown into prison.

events.title: 형부기선 벼슬을 사양하고 고향으로 돌아가다
events.title_en: He declined the post of Adviser to the Prince of Jing and went home
events.description: 옥에서 풀려난 뒤 형부기선이라는 벼슬을 받았으나 부임하지 않고 사퇴했다. 이후 회안부로 돌아가 뜻을 펴지 못한 채 시문을 지으며 만년을 보냈다.
events.description_en: After his release he was offered the post of Adviser to the Prince of Jing but declined to take it up. He returned to Huai'an and spent his later years writing poetry, his ambitions unfulfilled.

events.title: 서유기 백 회본을 완성하다
events.title_en: He completed the hundred-chapter Journey to the West
events.description: 만년에 손오공과 삼장법사의 서역 여정을 그린 서유기 백 회본을 완성했다. 훗날 동아시아 4대 기서의 하나로 꼽힌다.
events.description_en: In his later years he completed the hundred-chapter Journey to the West, recounting the pilgrimage of Sun Wukong and the monk Xuanzang to the west. It would later be counted among the Four Great Classical Novels of East Asia.

events.title: 회안에서 눈감다
events.description: 고향 회안부에서 여든셋의 나이로 숨을 거두었다.
events.description_en: He died in his hometown of Huai'an at the age of eighty-three.
